raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Bone-Loading Strength for Perimenopausal Female"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase maximal and structural strength for bone health"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower heavy":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Mixed bone-load":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          front_squat 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 8m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower heavy":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          military_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Mixed bone-load":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 8m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower heavy":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x4 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x5 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Mixed bone-load":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower deload and form":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_twist 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper deload and mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Mixed deload":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Progressive Load (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          military_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hip and posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 8m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower heavy singles/doubles":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x2 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x45..60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x5 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Mixed power and load":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower volume":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          military_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Posterior chain focus":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          good_morning 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload and recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_twist 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Mobility and light load":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30..45s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Intensification (Weeks 9-12)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower intensity increase":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 3x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper intensity increase":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x5 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 4x5 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hip and posterior intensity":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x5 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 8m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower peaking":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x2 rpe 9.5 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x5 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper peaking":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x4 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Heavy posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x2 rpe 9.5 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          good_morning 3x6 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Taper and controlled load":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper taper":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Mobility and recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Assessment and maintenance":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Assessment upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Recovery and program exit":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
